title: The lane lint reads UNKNOWN on a ready PR, so no combined PR can be lint-checked while it is ready
why: A combined PR cannot pass lane lint once it is marked ready, so it merges on an unknown, as #3292 did.
source: Coordinator 18:09 CST Nov 13: PR #3292 at merge time; the coordinator's account, unchecked by triage.
note: Filed 18:08 CST Nov 13. At merge time PR #3292's lane lint read UNKNOWN: the PR had been flipped back to draft after a ready run showed 3 red guard jobs from the arm rows; its record sat at an earlier head (51051ee89, comment 6867648570), and member #3289 had only a Haiku round 1 record. A lane reads first why lint is UNKNOWN on a ready PR (draft-only reads? a missing ready-run?). Do not lift the check to fit; fix the read. Relations: item 775 (macOS queue and lint unknown), express-combined-pr, review-record-restart-on-doc-nit, reviewer-round-1-model-vs-marker. A check change: test-author red case first, builder, reviewer. Past rulings not checked. Not started.
